title: Walmart issues worse-than-expected outlook as high gas prices hit shoppers, shares drop 7%
author: Sigma Capital
metaDescription: Walmart's CFO, John David Rainey, said higher tax returns helped offset the effect of elevated gas prices in the first quarter.
